I'm in the US. A man is on the phone with me right now saying my grandson has been arrested and needs cash for his legal fees. He says a courier can come to my house in an hour. What should I do?

What he's said so far:
Caller: I'm calling about your grandson. He has been arrested and he needs money for his legal fees today.
Me: Can I talk to him?
Caller: He can't come to the phone right now. Have $7,000 in cash ready. A courier will come to your house to pick it up.
Me: Should I call his parents?
Caller: Please don't, it will only make this harder for him. Stay on the line with me while you get the money together.

I'm in the US. I'm on a call right now with a man who says he has my daughter, and her phone is going straight to voicemail. He wants me to wire money and says not to hang up. What do I do?

What he's said so far:
(A girl screamed "Mom!" and there were sounds of a struggle.)
Caller: We have your daughter. She is being watched right now.
Me: Who is this?
Caller: You want her back, you pay $6,000. Don't talk to anyone. Don't hang up.
Me: I don't have that much in cash.
Caller: Then you wire it. Go to the wire counter now and stay on the phone with me. I'll tell you what to say.
